content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICAR CRRI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 2 for Young Professional I (YP I) and 2 for Field Assistant (FA).

content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Young Professional I (YP-I): B.Sc. in Agriculture / Botany / Biotechnology / Environmental Science / Microbiology / Molecular Biology. Experience in soil, plant and water analysis work in lab and field experimentation and preparation of scientific / technical reports / papers. Field Assistant (FA): Matriculation with +2 Vocational Agricultural related subject / Diploma in Agricultural related subject. OR Matric with two (02) years of working experience in agricultural related field work from reputed organization. Agricultural field related work / laboratory work.

content_sections.heading: ICAR CRRI Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Young Professional I (YP-I): Minimum Age: 21 years, Maximum Age: 45 years. Field Assistant (FA): Minimum Age: 18 years, Maximum Age: 50 years. Age relaxation will be as per government rules. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Young Professional-I is scheduled for 15th September 2026, and for Field Assistant, it is on 16th September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on these dates.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Young Professional-I and Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies. 2 vacancies are for the Young Professional-I post, and 2 vacancies are for the Field Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-I post?
faq.answer: For the Young Professional-I post, candidates must have a B.Sc. degree in Agriculture, Botany, Biotechnology, Environmental Science, Microbiology, or Molecular Biology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Field Assistant post, candidates need Matriculation with +2 Vocational in an Agricultural related subject or a Diploma in an Agricultural related subject, or Matric with two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-I and Field Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for Young Professional-I is between 21 to 45 years, and for Field Assistant, it is between 18 to 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Young Professional-I is Rs. 30,000/- per month (consolidated), and for Field Assistant, it is Rs. 18,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for ICAR CRRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring one recent passport-size photograph, original educational certificates (matriculation onwards) with Xerox copies, and relevant experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the ICAR CRRI located?
faq.answer: ICAR Central Rice Research Institute is located in Cuttack, Odisha, with the pincode 753006.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.
